integrity: The finding is proved by analytic Zak-fiber and Laurent-polynomial arguments; finite checker is supplementary. Novelty is relative to documented comparisons, independent review absent.
scientific_limitations: Only the Poisson window and lattice \(T_{\mathbb Z},M_{\mathbb Z/2}\); exact completeness classification for at most four entirely erased frequency rows. No general irregular mask, optimal frame bounds, or higher-row census is claimed.
title: Sharp completeness threshold for erased Poisson Gabor modulation rows
